title: Quiet-Loud Pattern · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Quiet-Loud Pattern · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on three gentle claps, some quiet and some louder. The lead performs the three-clap pattern and the partner copies it. The partner repeats the quiet and louder claps in order. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Quiet-Loud Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner repeats the quiet and louder claps in order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The partner repeats the quiet and louder claps in order.
